modules.name: FireTrack
modules.title: Digital Fire Safety Logbook | FireTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Keep your fire safety logbook on your phone: weekly fire alarm tests by call point, monthly emergency lighting tests, fire drills, extinguishers and fire doors, with reminders and a full history.
modules.heading: Digital fire safety logbook
modules.summary: FireTrack replaces the paper fire logbook. Staff record each check on a phone, ComplyTrack reminds them when the next one is due, and you can show an inspector the full history in seconds.
records: Weekly fire alarm tests, recorded against each call point so every one gets tested in turn
Escape route checks and alarm zones
Reminders the day before each check is due
law: England and Wales: Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005
Scotland: Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 and Fire Safety (Scotland) Regulations 2006
Weekly alarm testing follows BS 5839-1; emergency lighting testing follows BS 5266-1
modules.scotland: Scottish premises follow the Fire (Scotland) Act 2005 rather than the Fire Safety Order. The checks are much the same, and FireTrack records them the same way.

modules.name: KitchenTrack
modules.title: Food Safety Records App with CookSafe | KitchenTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Digital food safety diary for UK kitchens: opening and closing checks, fridge temperatures, cooking and cooling temps, deliveries and allergens. Supports CookSafe in Scotland and HACCP-based records.
modules.heading: Food safety records for busy kitchens
modules.summary: KitchenTrack is the kitchen diary on a phone or tablet. Opening and closing checks, temperatures and deliveries are quick to record, problems get a corrective action, and the manager signs off each day.
records: Corrective actions when something is out of limits
Manager sign-off and a weekly review based on CookSafe house rules
Allergen records alongside your daily checks
law: Food Safety Act 1990
Food hygiene rules requiring procedures based on HACCP principles (Regulation 852/2004 as kept in UK law)
Scotland: CookSafe from Food Standards Scotland. England: Safer Food Better Business from the Food Standards Agency
modules.scotland: In Scotland, kitchens usually follow CookSafe from Food Standards Scotland, and inspection results are shown as Pass or Improvement Required. KitchenTrack has CookSafe-style records built in.

modules.name: LegionellaTrack
modules.title: Legionella Log Book App | LegionellaTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Water safety logbook for legionella control: monthly hot and cold water temperature checks, sentinel outlets, flushing of little-used outlets, shower head cleaning and tank inspections.
modules.heading: Legionella and water safety records
modules.summary: LegionellaTrack keeps your water safety checks in one place. Temperatures are recorded in degrees C against each outlet, overdue checks are flagged, and the records support your legionella risk assessment and written scheme.
records: Hot and cold water temperature checks at sentinel outlets
Risk assessment review dates and actions
Overdue alerts by type of check
law: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974 and COSHH Regulations 2002
HSE Approved Code of Practice L8 and guidance HSG274

modules.name: TubTrack
modules.title: Hot Tub and Spa Pool Records App | TubTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Hot tub and spa pool logbook for holiday lets, parks and hotels: pH, sanitiser and temperature readings, operating limits per tub, and records based on HSE HSG282 and PWTAG guidance.
modules.heading: Hot tub and spa pool records
modules.summary: TubTrack is built for holiday parks, lodges and hotels with hot tubs. Each tub has its own operating limits, readings outside them are flagged straight away, and you can download the history as a PDF.
records: Operating limits set for each tub
A downloadable PDF record for each tub
law: HSE guidance HSG282: The control of legionella and other infectious agents in spa-pool systems
Pool Water Treatment Advisory Group (PWTAG) guidance

modules.name: AquaTrack
modules.title: Swimming Pool Records App | AquaTrack by ComplyTrack

modules.heading: Swimming pool water tests and safety checks
modules.summary: AquaTrack covers both sides of running a pool: the water quality tests, and the sessions and safety equipment around them, such as rescue equipment, first aid kits and defibrillators.
records: Safety equipment checks, including rescue poles, ring buoys, first aid kits and defibrillators
law: HSE guidance HSG179: Managing health and safety in swimming pools
Pool Water Treatment Advisory Group (PWTAG) guidance

modules.name: GreenTrack

modules.description: Greenkeeping records for golf clubs and grounds teams: machinery register, pre-use checks, PUWER inspections, defects, servicing and fuel logs, all on a phone in the shed.
modules.heading: Machinery and greenkeeping records for golf clubs
modules.summary: GreenTrack keeps every mower, tractor, sprayer and utility vehicle in one register. Greenkeepers do pre-use checks on a phone, defects are reported and tracked to a fix, and PUWER inspections and services have reminders.
records: Machinery register, including mowers, tractors, sprayers and spreaders
Pre-use checks: fluids, tyres, blades, guards and more
Defects reported and tracked until fixed
law: Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations 1998 (PUWER)
COSHH Regulations 2002 for the pesticides and fuels you store

modules.name: PestTrack

records: Pest control contractor visits, findings and treatments
Pest activity spotted by staff between visits
A PDF register ready for inspection
law: Food hygiene rules requiring adequate pest control in food businesses
Prevention of Damage by Pests Act 1949

modules.name: PATtrack
modules.title: PAT Testing Register App | PATtrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: In-house PAT testing register: a full appliance list by site and room, pass and fail results, failed appliances and replacements, and next test due dates.
modules.heading: PAT testing register
modules.summary: PATtrack keeps a full list of your portable appliances, where they are and when they were last tested. Results, failures and replacements are all recorded, and you can see what is due next across every site.
records: Appliance list by site and room
Failed appliances, where they were and what replaced them
law: Electricity at Work Regulations 1989
IET Code of Practice for In-service Inspection and Testing of Electrical Equipment

modules.name: TrainTrack
modules.title: Staff Training Records and Certificate Expiry | TrainTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Know who is trained in what and when it runs out: staff training records, certificate expiry reminders and staff sign-off, by site and department.
modules.heading: Staff training records
modules.summary: TrainTrack shows who is trained, in what, and when it expires. Staff can sign off training, and you get a reminder before certificates run out.
records: Training records for every member of staff
law: Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974
Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999

modules.name: TreeTrack
modules.title: Tree Inspection Records App | TreeTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: Tree inspection logbook for parks, golf courses and estates: visual checks, detailed surveys, post-storm checks and remedial works, with the location of each tree.
modules.heading: Tree inspection records
modules.summary: TreeTrack records every tree inspection with its location, result and any work needed, so you can show you are managing tree risk across your site.
records: Visual tree assessments and detailed surveys
Results from pass to urgent action
law: Occupiers' Liability Acts 1957 and 1984; in Scotland, the Occupiers' Liability (Scotland) Act 1960
BS 3998:2010 Tree work and National Tree Safety Group guidance

modules.name: IncidentTrack
modules.title: Digital Accident Book and RIDDOR Records | IncidentTrack by ComplyTrack
modules.description: A digital accident and incident book: who, what, where and when, the RIDDOR decision and reason, and the HSE reference and receipt when you report.

modules.summary: IncidentTrack replaces the paper accident book. Every incident records who was involved, what happened and where, and whether it is reportable under RIDDOR, with the reason and the HSE reference kept on file.
records: The RIDDOR decision and the reason for it
The HSE reference, date and receipt when reported
law: Reporting of Injuries, Diseases and Dangerous Occurrences Regulations 2013 (RIDDOR)
Social Security (Claims and Payments) Regulations 1979 accident book requirement
goodFor: Any business with staff or visitors

records: Faults reported by type, such as electrical, plumbing or heating
Status from reported to resolved, with solution notes
law: Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992: keeping the workplace and equipment maintained

modules.name: PremisesTrack

law: Workplace (Health, Safety and Welfare) Regulations 1992

templates.name: Fire alarm weekly test log
templates.title: Free Fire Alarm Weekly Test Log Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable fire alarm weekly test log for UK premises. Record the call point tested, whether sounders were heard, any faults and who tested it.
templates.heading: Fire alarm weekly test log
templates.summary: Test the fire alarm once a week, using a different call point each time so every one is tested in turn. Write down which call point you used and what happened.
guidance: Test at about the same time each week so staff and guests know it is a test.
Use a different manual call point each week and record its number or location.
Check that the alarm can be heard everywhere, including back rooms and outbuildings.
Report any fault to your fire alarm engineer and write down what was done.

templates.name: Emergency lighting monthly test log
templates.title: Free Emergency Lighting Test Log Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable emergency lighting monthly test record. Log each light or area checked, whether it lit, faults and actions.
templates.heading: Emergency lighting monthly test log
templates.summary: Once a month, switch off the normal lighting supply briefly and check every emergency light comes on. Once a year a competent person should do a full-length test.
guidance: Use the test key switch for a short test, then restore the power.
Walk every escape route and check each light or sign is lit.
Write down any light that failed and when it was fixed.
Keep this with your annual full-duration test certificate.

templates.name: Legionella water temperature log
templates.title: Free Legionella Water Temperature Log Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable legionella monthly water temperature log for sentinel outlets: hot water after one minute, cold water after two minutes, with actions.
templates.heading: Legionella water temperature log
templates.summary: Check the temperature at your sentinel outlets every month. These are usually the taps nearest to and furthest from the hot water heater or tank.
guidance: Hot water should reach at least 50°C within one minute of running.
Cold water should be below 20°C after running for two minutes.
If a reading is outside these limits, write down what you did about it.
Follow your own legionella risk assessment if it sets different checks.

templates.name: Little-used outlet flushing log
templates.title: Free Water Outlet Flushing Log Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable weekly flushing record for little-used taps and showers, a common legionella control in holiday parks, hotels and other sites.
templates.heading: Little-used outlet flushing log
templates.summary: Taps and showers that are not used often should be flushed regularly, usually once a week, so water does not sit still in the pipes.
guidance: List every little-used outlet named in your legionella risk assessment.
Run each one until the water is at its normal hot or cold temperature.
Run showers gently to avoid spray.
Record the date, the outlet and who did it.

templates.name: Hot tub water test log
templates.title: Free Hot Tub Water Test Log Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable hot tub and spa pool water test log for holiday lets, parks and hotels: pH, sanitiser, temperature and actions.
templates.heading: Hot tub water test log
templates.summary: Test the water before the tub is used and at the times your risk assessment sets. Write your own operating limits at the top so anyone testing knows what is in range.
guidance: Write your operating limits for pH and sanitiser in the boxes at the top.
Record every test, including the time.
If a reading is out of range, close the tub until it is corrected and write down what you did.
HSE guidance HSG282 explains how to manage spa pools safely.

templates.name: Fridge and freezer temperature log
templates.title: Free Fridge Temperature Log Sheet Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable fridge and freezer temperature log sheet for kitchens, with morning and afternoon readings and corrective actions.
templates.heading: Fridge and freezer temperature log
templates.summary: Check every fridge and freezer at least twice a day and write down the readings. Most kitchens aim for fridges at 5°C or below and freezers at minus 18°C or below.
guidance: Use a probe or the display, and say which in the notes.
If a fridge is too warm, check the food and move it if needed.
Write down what you did and who checked it.
In Scotland, CookSafe explains the checks Food Standards Scotland expects.

templates.name: NSTS sprayer test record
templates.title: Free NSTS Sprayer Test Record Template | ComplyTrack
templates.description: Free printable record of NSTS sprayer tests for golf clubs and grounds teams: each sprayer, its certificate number, test date and next test due.
templates.heading: NSTS sprayer test record
templates.summary: Professional pesticide sprayers need a valid test under the National Sprayer Testing Scheme (NSTS). Keep one line per sprayer so you can see when each test runs out.
guidance: List every sprayer and spreader you use for pesticides.
Copy the certificate number and test date from each NSTS certificate.
Check with NSTS how often your type of sprayer must be retested.
Keep the certificates with this sheet.
